newsitem.title: USA: Duke S.C. nuke seen reduced to mid-week.
newsitem.headline: Duke S.C. nuke seen reduced to mid-week.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 846 megawatt Oconee nuclear power unit 3 in Seneca, South Carolina is expected to operate near 63 percent of capacity through the middle of the week during repairs, a company spokeswoman said.
"We are in repairs after the failure of an oil pump," spokeswoman Guynn Savage said Monday. "We expect the repairs to be complete about mid-week."

Power at the unit was reduced Sunday evening after a feedwater pump tripped off line, Savage said. Power was not expected go below 63 percent, and should be ramped up to full immediately following the repairs, she said.
